description: This file defines the SensorStats class which provides static methods to perform statistical and transformation operations on sensor data streams, such as measuring range, standard deviation, delta, and conversion. It manages sensor data updates and communicates with other parts of the system for data processing and output.

classes.name: SensorStats
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for sensor data statistical analysis and conversion.

methods.name: startRangeMeasurement
methods.description: Sets up a listener to measure the range (difference between max and min values) of a sensor over every 10 updates and sends the result to a destination sensor.

methods.name: startStandardDeviation
methods.description: Sets up a listener to calculate and output the standard deviation of sensor values over a window of 30 samples.

methods.name: startDelta
methods.description: Sets up a listener to compute and output the difference (delta) between two sensors, scaled by system ticks per millisecond.

methods.name: startConversion
methods.description: Sets up a listener to apply a conversion to sensor values before outputting to a destination sensor.
